info.title: radioso API
info.description: Code-generated OpenAPI contract for the radioso backend

metadataRules.description: Always empty for system retrieval defaults.

embeddingModel.description: The embedding model currently used for document indexing and retrieval.

assistantBootstrapActive.description: Server-managed bootstrap readiness derived from the current assistant configuration.

title.description: Optional title to use instead of the source filename.

documentEnrichmentOverride.description: Force metadata extraction on or off for this import's processing run only.

retrievalEnabled.description: When false, the document is excluded from retrieval regardless of processing status.

retrievalExpiresAt.description: Instant after which the document is auto-excluded from retrieval. Null when no expiry is set.

ChatSuggestionAction.description: Behavior triggered when the user activates the suggestion chip. Absent means ask_followup (default: submit the chip text as a new user turn).

reason.description: Execution routing reason chosen by the assistant surface after intent and policy checks.

generator.description: The human-facing assistant surface that produced this response.

routeReason.description: Route reason echoed into diagnostics for replay and history views.

namespace.description: Capability that produced this sub-trace; the renderer keys on it (e.g. retrieval, skill-intake).

payload.description: Opaque capability-owned trace payload (e.g. an ActivityTrace). Shape varies by namespace/version.

traceId.description: Active OpenTelemetry trace id for correlating this product diagnostic turn with exported traces.

spanId.description: Active OpenTelemetry span id at the point the turn trace envelope was built.

sampled.description: Whether the active OpenTelemetry span context was sampled.

TurnTraceOpenTelemetryCorrelation.description: Debug-only OpenTelemetry correlation. Contains primitive trace identity only; no SDK span objects or payload data are embedded.

version.description: Envelope generation marker. 0 = synthesized from a legacy turn; >=1 = engine-emitted spine.

ChatBootstrapResponse.description: Ephemeral bootstrap greeting response. Conversation id is omitted until the first persisted user turn. The optional bootstrap greeting id can be sent with the first user message to save the displayed greeting in conversation history.

AssistantChatRequest.description: `message` is required unless `startConversation` is true; bootstrap requests cannot include `conversationId`.

PublicChatRequest.description: `message` is required unless `startConversation` is true; bootstrap requests cannot include `conversationId`.

tailCursor.description: Cursor for subsequent tail requests. It marks the newest message included when this detail response was produced.

count.description: Turns matching the metric within the window.

denominator.description: Turns the metric is defined over.

rate.description: `count / denominator`, or null when the denominator is zero.

allOf.description: Grounded answers over turns that attempted one. Outcomes the skill catalog leaves unflagged, such as a clarifying question, are in neither the count nor the denominator.
Turns with at least one down vote, over turns with any vote. A turn with several votes counts once.
Turns whose skill ended in `failed`, over all turns.
Equal length, immediately preceding the current window.

buckets.description: Current window only, one entry per UTC day, zero-filled.

backlog.description: Turns still in an active triage state (`open` or `acknowledged`) per signal. All-time and independent of `range`.

data.description: Arbitrary JSON value. The HTTP API rejects values above the serialized size limit.
Arbitrary JSON value. The HTTP API rejects values above the serialized size limit.

AssistantChatSseStream.description: A server-sent event stream. Status payloads use the named ChatStatusEvent schema. Successful order: status(interpreting), conversation (when available), status(searching) for retrieval, status(composing), one or more chunk events, done, then optional suggestions. A cancelled event is terminal and no event follows it.

PublicChatSseStream.description: A server-sent event stream. Status payloads use the named ChatStatusEvent schema. Successful order: status(interpreting), conversation (when available), status(searching) for retrieval, status(composing), one or more chunk events, done, then optional suggestions. A cancelled event is terminal and no event follows it.

get.summary: List low-quality assistant turns
get.description: Returns assistant turns for the dashboard's quality review surface. Admin/owner only (requires the `workspace.quality.read` permission). Filters apply to operator signal, skill action, skill status, user feedback, latency, agent, channel, and time range. Operator-test conversations and replies authored by a human teammate are excluded.

schema.description: Comma-separated `QualitySignalId` values (`negative_feedback`, `grounding_gaps`, `slow_responses`, `skill_failures`), resolved server-side from the skill catalog. A turn matches if it carries any listed signal, and the result is layered on top of the other filters rather than replacing them.

parameters.description: Comma-separated `QualitySignalId` values (`negative_feedback`, `grounding_gaps`, `slow_responses`, `skill_failures`), resolved server-side from the skill catalog. A turn matches if it carries any listed signal, and the result is layered on top of the other filters rather than replacing them.
parameters.name: signal

schema.description: When true, only turns with written feedback comments are returned. When false, only turns without written feedback comments are returned.

parameters.description: When true, only turns with written feedback comments are returned. When false, only turns without written feedback comments are returned.
parameters.name: hasComment

get.summary: Read assistant answer-quality statistics
get.description: Returns answer-quality rates for a rolling window, the equal-length window before it, one zero-filled bucket per UTC day, and the all-time active-triage backlog per signal. Admin/owner only (requires the `workspace.quality.read` permission). Every rate ships with the population it is defined over, and reports `null` rather than a rate when that population is empty. The turn population matches `GET /api/v1/quality/turns`: operator-test conversations and replies authored by a human teammate are excluded.

allOf.description: Length of the health window. Defaults to `30d`.

parameters.description: Length of the health window. Defaults to `30d`.
parameters.name: range
